title: Left exact sheafification for Grothendieck abelian coefficients
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal V$. Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a $\mathcal V$-small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category relative to $\mathcal V$, with $\mathcal V$-small morphism sets [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Let $\operatorname{PSh}(\mathcal C;\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A)$ and let $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal A)$ be its full subcategory of sheaves: for each $T\in\mathcal A$, the presheaf of sets $U\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(T,F(U))$ is a sheaf. The inclusion $\iota$ admits a left adjoint $a$ (sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]), and $a$ preserves finite limits [def-galois-finite-limits-colimits]. The category $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J;\mathcal A)$ is abelian.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-presentable-generator-cardinal-bound] with $X=\operatorname{Mor}(\mathcal C)$. It gives a generator $G$ and an infinite regular $\kappa\in\mathcal V$ with $G$ $\kappa$-presentable and $|\operatorname{Mor}(\mathcal C)|<\kappa$. These are precisely the hypotheses required below.

proof.text: Use the functorial matching-family plus iteration $Q_\kappa$ and its canonical unit $\eta$ specified in [lem-sfb-transfinite-plus-sheaf-convergence]. That node makes every $Q_\kappa(P)$ a Hom-tested sheaf for the $G,\kappa$ of step 1. Corestrict this functor to sheaves, calling it $a$. Its object is the explicitly constructed $Q_\kappa(P)$, and its maps are the same natural transformations; fullness leaves identities and composition unchanged.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-transfinite-plus-sheaf-orthogonality], precomposition with $\eta_P$ gives natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{PSh}}(\iota a(P),\iota F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{PSh}}(P,\iota F)$ for every sheaf $F$. Fullness identifies the left side with $\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Sh}}(a(P),F)$. These are exactly the adjunction $a\dashv\iota$ and the universal property in [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-transfinite-plus-finite-limits] with the same $G,\kappa$. Its corestricted functor is exactly the $a$ of step 2, so $a$ preserves finite limits. This uses the same construction throughout, with no identification of independently chosen reflectors.

proof.text: The category $\mathcal A$ is abelian by [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Apply [lem-sfb-abelian-sheaves-left-exact-reflector] with $\mathcal B=\mathcal A$ and $L=a$, using the adjunction and finite-limit preservation from steps 3 and 4. It gives abelianness of the same Hom-tested sheaf category, completing the statement.
